parts: Random few-shot sampling silently kills your prompt cache.
I learned this debugging $40 of Anthropic spend that should have been $4.
If your few-shot examples rotate per call, every call is a cache miss.
Pin 3-5 stable examples. That's the whole trick.
The 'random for diversity' instinct misfires here — diversity comes from the user's article, not the prefix.
Net effect on my voice editor: $1/mo instead of $10. Zero quality regression.
If you pay for cached prompts at all, this is the easiest 5x you'll find.
